g.text: Dopamine always drains — act across windows to refill it and chain your focus.
A frontend-only arcade satire of the attention economy. Survive on constant
stimulation across five fictional services until your Dopamine runs dry.
Design, code and art — Grupo Kiss.
Built with Vite, TypeScript, React, Canvas 2D and Web Audio.
Loop clips — placeholder pack, license pending. Attribution slot reserved.

Loop, Pulse, Wave, Echo and Alerts are fictional services. They are parodies of
platform behaviour patterns and are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or derived
from any real product, company, or trademark.
